nom: Drunk Elephant Bouncy Brightfacial Brightening Mask

avis.texte: I got a gift of the Drunk Elephant Bouncy Brightfacial Mask from Ulta, I only used it one time and I was amazed at how my skin was noticeably better after one use. The formula made my skin flawless. I applied it before my make up and for the first time ever my skin is smooth, light, clear, no signs of oil or fine lines and blotchiness. My make up sets perfect now following this leave on mask. It is light weight no feeling of it after applied just better skin.
My absolute favorite to add to my routine when my skin is looking dull. It's amazing! Within 1-2 days of use, my skin is clear and glowing.
The actual fountain of youth. Serious noticeable difference in a week. I've never used any skincare that actually made a difference like this. Drunk Elephant I love you
Bouncy Brightfacial didn't fade any of the spots on my face. I saw no noticeable benefit from using this product nightly until the bottle was empty.
One of my favorites. It soaks in so nice and helps with my rosacea.
this did exactly as I needed. got rid of my rosacea redness. love this Cream texture

This product irritates my skin like crazy, it also pulls and I don't see much of a difference comparing to just using salicylic acid. If you have sensitive skin, don't even bother and please don't use this during the day (I see a lot of reviews of people saying they use it day and night) It's also really expensive and just not the best for dark spots or exfoliation

well I tried it and immediately fell in love was told there's a dupe not been able to try would like to suppose to be very similar in ingredients called a cure night cream let me know if anyone tried?

avis.titre: I ordered this in high hopes
avis.texte: I put this under my moisterizer and it started peeling off my face im not sure why
I fell in love with Drunk Elephant product line in the last year. I recommended it to anyone. The moisturizer and serum are so lightweight for your skin.

Why, oh whyyyy does this have to be so $$$?? Its sooo good. I cannot find a dupe that works as well as this to reduce the redness, reduce the occurrence of my acne rosacea pimples, and reduce my rosacea flare ups as quickly as this. Its the perfect combo of azelic and salicylic acids. I use it every night under a heavy cream moisturizer, I cannot quit. It is worth every penny of my hard-earned money for how well it illuminates my skin without peeling and destroying my skin barrier. I am confident with my skin for once in my 35 years.

Very surprised by the good reviews. This is very harsh and drying. Created more redness and more unneveness. Also not comfortable to leave on - feels harsh. Not happy at all - huge waste of money and will throw in trash. I feel like I need to get some extreme hydration cream to counter the effects of this.

This is such a unique product. Ive never seen real results with Vitamin C products other than Ole Henriksen eye cream but when you put this on it almost immediately transforms your skin appearance. My dark spots disappeared. Its the weirdest thing. Like almost immediately my skin was brighter. How is that possible? Im now weeks in and have seen a tiny bit of a difference (other than the immediate disappearancing witchcraft) so I'll continue to use when I'm out of product to see if I'll eventually see long term results.

avis.titre: The secret to curing my acne and dark spots
avis.texte: I have struggled with hormonal acne since I was a teenager. I also always get hyper pigmentation after a pimple. I tried a few vitamin C serums for over two years, even the high end ones, but all would cause me to break out still after awhile. I tried this product since it was more of a cream and within two weeks i noticed a difference. I use slightly less than a pump every morning and my first bottle lasted about 7 months. Its expesnive so i waited a bit to buy another bottle and my acne came back after a bit. Once i re-bought this my skin was back to being clear and glowy. It really is a holy grail and worth the money. I have very oily skin so i think my trick is to use cream based products instead of serums.

I bought this on a whim. I knew it had some good reviews online but I didnt know much about it. Wow. After a week of using it daily in the morning I could see a difference. My face looks and feels so smooth. I now wear minimal makeup because I feel like I dont need it as much. For context, Ive always had acne. Less now than in my teenage years but I still had some texture. After incorporating this into my routine, my acne has gone down and some wrinkles have smoothened.
This treatment has nearly erased a huge age spot on my cheek in 2 months. I mix it with bhydra or protini or both and 2 drops of marula oil and it sinks in so quickly
Usually a fan of Drunk Elephant products but this one wasn't for me. It made me break out, when normally I don't struggle with acne. It also made my skin dry and dull.

I am a 32 year old first time mom. I've been neglecting my skin lately. My skin has been dry, broken out, and showing signs of aging. I wanted to give azelaic acid a try and found this product. Ive used it exactly as directed. This is truly THE FIRST PRODUCT in my life I can label "holy grail". My skin is so bright, clear, tighter, and smoother. I cleanse, moisturize, and apply 2 pumps every night. And its working! Will absolutely repurchase.

avis.titre: I didn't know this was gonna be this good
avis.texte: my skin is better, i didn't tought it was gonna be this good :D recomended for an oily face prone to acne

avis.titre: Best at clearing texture I've ever seen.
avis.texte: I've been on a skin care journey trying to clear my texture. Nothing has worked. This I saw instant changes the very next morning. I've never had this smooth of skin and it is still getting better!
I use this product with the Protini Moisturizer every morning and night. It controls the redness I get from rosacea and the papules too! So happy with this product.

I really wanted this product to work—it was sticky and dried out my skin. I dont apply too much product, but this wasn't good for my sensitive skin. I tried for over 2 months and dodnt really notice a difference. I won't repurchase.

This is by far the best OTC skincare product i hsve purchased in a long time. I have noticed a drastic change in the appearance of my skin. My skin is substantially more smooth, even, & soft from this. I lovd it so much thst i use it morning snd nigjt. Be sure to wear sunscreen (even if using at night). And my skin is sensitive & acne prone. This does not cayse any problems at all. & its packed with sooo mang great ingredients. I will be keeping this in my routine!
This product worked well even on my sensitive skin. However it did feel unpleasantly sticky and was difficult to wash off which lead to a lot of rubbing.
I was so looking forward to trying this because I love the Fbalm product. This is not similar, it is sticky and smells like ham.
Made my skin break out... not a great product but you get a decent amount for the price.
Adding this to my daily routine has really helped with my skin which is naturally red and irritated. My skin is noticeably smoother and less red.

I love this mask and use it with cfirma every morning. I have started to run out and noticed a difference when I went with out for only a few days. It has helped even out the oily tzone. I have never had much luck with salicylic acid in the past.

I love this product! Highly recommend!! I have a solid routine and I usually stick with the same products , so I was really impressed after I introduced this into my routine. My skin type is normal and I've noticed within a few days of using it it smoothed my texture and brighted my skin. I wo
My face is really sensitive to new products. BUT my face LOVES this new bright bouncy facial. It works amazing and is really helping lighten up my dark spots!

I was a little afraid to try it because I thought it might be too strong. I'm glad I took a chance on Bouncy Brightfacial. I really like it! I started to use it every other night as directed; it feels great on my skin.
I absolutely love this! My skin has neve looked this good! I can already see such an improvement after 4 weeks of using the product. I am absolutely hooked on this!
This is the only skin care product that have tried to reduce my rosacea redness and pustules that actually works!!!!!!

I have struggled with adult acne for years, and this is hands down the best product I have ever used. I assumed it would take a few weeks to really kick in, but within days I noticed a remarkable difference in how my skin looked and felt. I could not recommend this product highly enough.

avis.titre: Disappointing,made me get a rash an stripped skin!
avis.texte: I was really hopeful that this would be another great drunk elephant product. I used it and it totally stripped my skin it is not moisturizing it is quite the opposite! It also made me break out. It's way too harsh and obviously not fragrance free or has too much chemicals. Super super disappointed.

I use this moisturizer with the D-Bronzi drops and absolutely love it! The moisturizer evens my skin and the bronzer adds just enough color and glow. It lasts all day and never gets oily and it doesn't take much at all.
I love this bright facial. I love how lightweight it feels on my skin. It goes in east and keep in the moisture through the entire day. I have definitely seen a difference in my skin.
I received this product complimentary of Influencer , I love that this product cleared any breakouts and helped reduce my dark spots. I would recommend This product

Not sure where they came up with the name of this product, but my skin is not left "bouncy" or hydrated in any way. To not let it go to waste, I've been using this when breakouts occur on my chin, which it doesnt really help much with that either. I expected soooooo much more from this high dollar product. Will not be repurchasing.

I saw a tiktok where the drunk elephant bronzer drops were used with a moisturizer from a different line. I went into Ulta with the goal of testing the bronzer drops and started mixing them with 3 drunk elephant moisturizers. The bouncy brightfacial was definitely my fave combo! You get the benefits of redness reducer and color corrector in the moisturizer, plus the added subtle natural bronzing affect. The only thing that would improve this product is if it was packaged like the other moisturizers so you could easily mix them on the lid
Best cream ever it's kinda thick but not overly so and it soaks in well. I always feel dewy the next morning and the r using it. I definitely recommend

I've been using this product for about 6 weeks and can definitely notice an improvement in fine lines and overall radiance. I started noticing results after a few days of incuding in my skin care routine. My skin feels firmer and has a glow. I highly recommend
I use this stuff every single day. Drunk elephant has become a staple in my skin care regimen. I never knew these products existed before my Voxbox
Have tried this product now for over 30 days. Tried it in the evening and in the morning as part of my skin care routine and have come to the conclusion this product really dries out my skin

avis.titre: Holy grail of skincare for me!
avis.texte: I received a sample of this product and used it daily for a week. I am now a customer for as long as this product exists! My skin has never felt or looked smoother and more glowing! It also helped with redness. I now use in combination with polypeptide resurfacing serum, Lala Retro whipped cream moisturizer, and B Hydra. At night I use TLC Framboos instead of resurfacing serum, and I use TLC Sukari Babyfacial once a week. My skin is so happy now!
This is one of my holy-grail products, it brightens your complexion instantly and I recommend to literally everyone!

I've had the worst breakout from new landlords having building renovations on my floor unannounced with dark spots appearing on my face my arms my legs my back and my chest. I haven't been able to socialize and go to many places because I don't want my friends asking if everything ok! I found out about drunk elephant from YouTube reviews never heard of the company. When it arrived in a small pump bottle I thought it wouldn't be enough to help me with all areas. Once applied it started working! So far its faded dark spots on my arm and my legs and chest with the one on my face I'm still working on since my face is always exposed. I like it!

I haven't seen any dramatic results yet, which is maybe to be expected. I do like the matte texture, though, for mixing with TLC Framboos at night (which I find to have a tacky texture by itself). I'm taking off stars since even combined with the TLC Framboos every night, I'm still looking for more results. I'm definitely grateful that it didn't break out my sensitive skin, though.
I'm in love again. This makes my skin feel soft and supple, I look bright and awake. This week, 3 people told me how good I looked. Wow!
This product is very lightweight and moisturizing! It definitely is worth the price which is very reasonable ! Great for moisturizing daily even under makeup

I do love this brands products, but I did expect more from this product in comparison to its price. For being a mask it is quite thin when applying, but that's not necessarily a bad or a good thing. The mask seemed to sting a tiny tiny bit on my skin but I don't care about that because I used to have acne and I'm used to products like that. I expected a little more evening out of my skin and for it to make me glow just a bit more. It's pretty middle of the line with what it did for me. With that being said it wasn't a bad product by any means just wishing it had a bit more umpf.

I have suffered from acne the past 15 years. I have tried EVERYTHING from proactive in the early 2000s to nearly all the brands Ulta offers. DE is the only skin product line that has cleared up breakouts and reduce post inflammatory redness! I have used Bouncy Brightfacial for 3 months now, and I am amazed with the results. So happy I finally found a product that works with my skin!
I definitely loved this product, I love it and enjoyed it as much as others I would be recommending this to friends and family so they can try it out as well
Received a sample of this and immediately fell in love. It makes my skin feel and look amazing!

I'm not sure if I got a bad batch but this dries down completely matte and feels like I put a pimple paste or something on my entire face - it dries down completely. MATTE. There is nothing moisturizing about this. I will say… it does seem to brighten but it's dry dry dry.

avis.titre: Very good but nothing unseen before
avis.texte: I am really into skincare and do not have a sensitive skin. I could notice that this facial mask helped me with redness and large pores. I used mostly at night but sometimes during my day routine too. It has a mattifying effect which I like very much and I works great as a primes as well. It feels very lightweight. I recommend it but it's not magical.

Love this product so much! I use it 2/3 times a week and everytime I wake up after using it the night before i see the difference! My face is more clear, less sensitive and shows improvement everytime i use! Definitely would reccomend
This was a new product for me. I can definitely tell a difference in my complexion with the addition of this facial. I feel like it has definitely evened it out.
I don't know what kind of magic potion is in this little bottle but you need it! I put it on every night after washing my face and it's made the biggest difference in my skin!

Upon receiving this I thought the effects were going to be substantial however, after using it consistently I really didn't see much improvement in the texture of my skin. I will say it helped to moisturize but that's about it. Not sure id recommend for purchase.
my face felt refreshed and brighter. My skin was brighter and glowing in a way it's never been before. I absolutely love this product. 10/10 would recommend
My new favorite DE product. Texture is amazing. Helped with hyper pigmentation.

avis.titre: Did not really notice a difference..
avis.texte: I did not really notice a difference in my skin while using this unfortunately. I am usually very impressed with drunk elephant products but not this time.

I have had this product for about 2 weeks and when I tell you that this is single handedly clearing up my acne and post inflammatory pigmentation idk what else to tell you. I have moderate to severe acne and my dermatologist said i am now moving down the scale to mild to moderate acne. This has made a huge difference in my skin and overall self esteem.

avis.titre: Will be buying for as long as they make it
avis.texte: I have rosacea and cystic acne + blackheads & scarring. I've tried so many prescription products and never got great results. I read Azelaic acid helps and got this and it's amazing. Less redness, no cystic acne, less scars, and less blackheads!

This brightening serum has been the best purchase I've made. The Murad vitamin C has done nothing for my skin but the first night i tried this DE one, I saw a huge difference overnight. I wasnt expecting anything drastic but all the redness I had from acne were jsut gone the next morning. Ive had it for a week and everyone's commented how my acnes clearing up and asking if I went back and got laser facials. This is truly a miracle in a bottle
Made my skin look more youthful and smooth. Also minimized dark spots and improved the overall texture. I would recommend and purchase this product! Thank you!
Where has this been all my life?! LOVE it! You won't be disappointed.

I usually don't break out very much just the occasional pimple during that time of the month. I put it on one time and my face turned very red but it was not burning. I decided to leave it on over night which was a big mistake my face is broken out now from cheeks to chin several pimples everywhere I am devastated

I loved this product after the first use. I put 2 pumps on in the morning with sunscreen and within a few days my skin was noticeably brighter. I have a lot of freckles and hyper pigmentation and it has helped both with the spots and redness across my chin and cheeks. I did reduce to 1 pump as I felt my skin felt more sensitive after 2 weeks, but overall still love it.

At first I wasn't sure if this was the cause of my flawless foundation coverage….BUT IT WAS!!!! I have combo skin and I definitely have some fine lines going on but this product (applied as part of my morning and nighttime skin routine) evened out my skin textures and seriously has my skin looking airbrushed. Super Soft Skin!
It's definitely not something I would be going out of my way to buy but it was nice trying out the product sickle it was sent to me, probably wouldn't be buying it again thought.

I really liked this product. My skin was actually moisturized and glowing after using it. My only complaint is the packaging. There is no lid and you cannot turn the dispenser to close it. So I can't bring it with me when I travel.

I was skeptical after applying the sample package at night time because it felt a bit tight but boy was I wrong! My skin was so soft and smooth the next day. I purchased the full size the next day and would not want to be without it!

This brand never fails me! This helped both brighten any hyperpigmentation and it helped with my texture! — this also layered beautifully with other skincare products and underneath makeup! A new staple!!

The leave-on mask claims to boost radiance, clarify uneven tone, and fade spots. After using it both day and night, I did notice it improve the tone of my skin making it more even. Another thing I liked was that this product contained sacylic acid which helped with my acne prone skin. I did wish the mask was more moisturizing. I have combination skin but my skin gets really dry in the winter. This mask did not help moisturize my skin at all so if you have dry skin I would suggest you stay away from this product. Overall, great for improving skin tone.

This was my first purchase with the DE brand. I received the sample size of this and immediately fell in love and had to have it. Slowly working in different products from this brand, this is seriously my top 5 fav products!

I tried this for the first time a few weeks ago & my skin is so clear & bright. I love all Drunk Elephant products & this is no exception. Dramatically improved the dullness & reduced the size of my pores. My skin has never looked better.
I always love drunk elephant products. I was excited to try the drink elephant bouncy bright facial. I used it on nights that a exfoliate. It didn't burn or irritate my skin.
I have a new found love for drink elephant products. This facial lotion is amazing! It smells great, helps brighten my skin and goes on so smooth.
This product is absolutely amazing and so great for your skin!
This product is great made my skin so much better! There isn't much of a smell to it and went on very nicely. I would purchase this again in the future
I love this product so much. Brightens and tightens the skin really well with no irritation for my sensitive skin!! Love everything about drunk elephant.

I love this product! I wear this under my makeup and it leaves my face very smooth and closes my pores. I like how it sets into my face very quickly and it doesn't have a strong scent like most moisturizers.
I love this I use it nightly. It does help with resurfacing the skin. I would recommend using a rich moisturizer especially if you have a dryer or more sensitive skin

avis.titre: Leaves skin feeling soft and exfoliated
avis.texte: I received this product for free in exchange for my honest opinion and I absolutely loved it. It worked wellP exfoliating my skin well left my skin, feeling soft and subtle, easy to use I highly recommend. The movie purchasing the future.

I bought this because someone on tiktok recommended azelaic acid for perioral dermatitis. I saw results immediately. I showered and applied this as my last step before bed. I was in disbelief at how good my skin looked when I woke up. My skin looks so much better since I started using this.
I've been using this for several weeks and have noticed a difference in my complexion. It looks brighter & almost smoother. Will continue to use!
I tryed it and it was so smooth and it made my skin so soft I use it on a daily and it's really good for your skin it has good ingredients really good for you skin
I recently started using this when I saw it advertised at Sephora and I love it. I mix it with my vitamin c and my skin looks great. I haven't noticed a scent and it's light weight.

I'm so impressed with this mask that I felt compelled to make a review. I use it over my skincare morning and night. My skin is very sensitive so I use almost exclusively Drunk Elephant for my skincare anyway. This was a game changer though!! I've never used anything like it and I don't have anything else in my skincare collection that does what this mask does. I use F-Balm religiously so this was a no brainer for me to get when it came out. My skin was instantly tighter (in a good way) and my redness looked clearer after just a few minutes. No breakouts since I started using this either! 10/10

First of all, look at that packaging, the brightness of the colors, the patterns, just amazing. The simple but effective detail to close the product and keep it safe from contamination. And the products works really well, every morning after using it my skin feels and looks amazing, brighter and smoother

Love love love this product! I have used to many drunk elephant products and I'm never disappointed. Not only does the bouncy bright facial make my skin feel so much smoother, it evened out some dark spots that I had on my cheek. Definitely recommend.
I love love this! I use it every night before bed! And my face has never been so clearer and bright! A small pea size goes a long ways! Keeps my face feeling moisturized with out feeling heavy!
I loved this product from the first use. It really does brighten up your facial complextion and leaves it soft and smooth all day long with no oily residue
Got a sample and me and my sister tried it bc we both suffer from dark acne scars and both of our faces looked glowy and nice! We waited till it hardened to wash off and it did the job!

I have some side hyperpigmitation and issues with the side of my face. It didn't really change much for my main issues that i wish to change. However, I think this is because I'm a side face sleeper. I think this was a product where I was not sure how best to use and what products to not use. However, I did enjoy the product as it was leightweight!
Plumps your face and makes fine lines and wrinkles disappear!! LOVE THIS!!
Applied smoothly, I see some changes in the dark spots on my face. So far I like it
Is it okay to use this in the morning if I am going to use Babyfacial that night?

My skin feels tight, clean and not greasy, it goes on well and evenly. My makeup slides nicely on it. I've been using it for a couple of weeks now and can't tell a difference in wrinkles or color evening out. I have a feeling it will do well.

It gets the job done, well and fast. It does as promised and you can see the improvement overnight. i love applying this at night on important days where i know I'll be taking pictures, because I know I will wake up with my skin looking brighter and more even!

I love Drunk Elephants Bouncy BrightFacial Moisturizer. I put it on at night, and I wake up with a beautiful glow. I highly recommend this product constantly for anyone looking to diminish hyperpigmentation and acne scarring.

The Drunk Elephant Bouncy Brightfacial is a unique product in my book. I hadn't tried any leave on exfoliating masks before and was initially worried about my skin drying out or becoming irritated, but that didn't happen at all! I've been struggling with acne more lately, so the salicylic & azelaic acid absolutely helped me out and led me towards brighter, smoother looking skin.

I've had a great experience testing this product so far! I'll say though that I'm experienced with salicylic acid and a beginner should start slowly if they have sensitive skin. I typically use this at night. In the morning I wake up with smooth skin and less visible pores. I'm eager to see more fading of dark spots with continued use!
This product evened out my skin tone and got rid of my redness. It's very easy to apply and a little goes a long way. I love the texture and that absorbs well while not being sticky.

this has changed my life. I have suffered from acne for YEARS and could never get rid of acne marks, long after the pimple had faded until now!! ladies - twice a day after your moisturizer. My dark spots have faded so much faster than anything else I've tried, and I think I look brighter overall. This has been added to my holy grail list.
I loved this product, the texture is incredible, it absorbs very well on your face. Your face feels glowing and hydrated, not to mention the packaging is crazy beautiful 😍
Used the entire container of this product consistently for two months and really didn't see any noticeable difference. It is nice but at its price point there are better options.

I've always had super red skin where my nostrils meet my face. Since using this product, the skin around my nostrils is the same color as the rest of my face! I've also noticed that the pores that are usually super visible on my nose are smaller. I'm a big big fan.

After using the product for a few weeks I can say it evened out my skin tone and made my face more radiant. I feel it helped moderately with my redness —which is always there since I am so fair. I did wish it helped more with acne, given its composition. It's very easy to apply and a little goes a long way. I love the texture and that absorbs well while not being sticky.
It's fast acting and clears up all of my acne. My skin is much smoother. A lot of my dark marks or scars have cleared up. I'll more than likely be purchasing this product soon.

Just an ok product. Been using for awhile and really haven't noticed much of a difference in my skin. I am extremely dry and don't feel like this moisturized well at all. Idk maybe I need to keep using it because I'm indifferent on how I feel about it right now.

I love all DE products, however, this just straight up made my skin like a 17 yo. I'm 37. It is amazing. My skin had such even tone and smooth!!! I usually have scattered redness. This took it all away.
Can't really notice any changes since I've used it, but the texture of this goes on very nice

First of all this brand normally makes amazing products, however I didn't see a fade in dark spots. It caused my skin to shed which was great because my skin has an amazing glow every time I use it. It also has helped keep new acne at bay.

Loved the smell of this product but I was a bit disappointed that it made my face peel after a few days of using it. Perhaps my skin had to work it's way up to it because I have used this brand before and had no problems. I will try again in the future but for now will need a rest.

I've used this product for 2-3 weeks now and while I think it's a good product I don't think it's amazing. I still had breakouts while using this product. The product package seems unnecessarily big for how much product there actually is. The dispense gets clogged easily unless you put the cap back on which is also easy to lose. Overall, I think money is better spend elsewhere for better results.

I actually use this product every single day twice a day. I've struggled with acne for my entire life and I have a lot of post acne dark spots. I've been using this for 2 months since it launched on DE and i've never seen such a change.I wish I took before and afters.
